name: Model Usage
author: DigitalPals
description: Track Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, and Kimi Code subscription limits from your Omarchy menu bar. Connect local CLIs, Fusebox, or CLIProxyAPI to see every account's remaining quota, resets, and credits. Explore 24-hour, 7-day, and 30-day token history and estimated API costs from Fusebox, local Codex/Claude transcripts, or T3 Code servers, with cache-aware pricing, custom model rates, and provider/model breakdowns. Includes private account labels, quota history, and keyboard controls.

barWidget.description: AI subscription quotas from local CLIs, Fusebox, or CLIProxyAPI, per-account limits and resets, and combined Codex/Claude token history and API cost estimates from local and T3 Code sources.

schema.label: Quota source
schema.description: direct reads local CLI sign-ins; proxy reads Fusebox or CLIProxyAPI accounts (detected automatically). Older settings with cliproxy are read as proxy.

schema.label: Fusebox / CLIProxyAPI server URL
schema.description: Server, management.html, or /v0/management URL for Limits. Costs reuses it for Fusebox history unless another server is set. HTTPS certificates are verified.

schema.label: Proxy management key file
schema.description: Managed automatically by the settings menu when saving a Management API key. Advanced users can supply an existing private key file path here.

schema.label: Hide account emails
schema.description: Replace account usernames and email addresses with numbered labels and hide account identity in settings.

schema.label: Square usage cards
schema.description: Use square corners for cards in Limits instead of the theme's corner style.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often provider usage is refreshed. Manual refresh is always available.

schema.label: Providers
schema.description: Select local CLI providers. Fusebox and CLIProxyAPI discover all managed providers automatically.

schema.label: Bar display
schema.description: Percentages shows compact remaining quota on horizontal bars and falls back to the icon on vertical bars.

schema.label: Menu bar providers
schema.description: Enabled providers allowed to show percentage chips in the menu bar. Hidden providers remain in the popup.

schema.label: Custom model prices
schema.description: Managed by Custom prices in the Costs tab of settings. Exact model IDs mapped to USD-per-million input/output and optional cache rates as JSON.

schema.label: CPA Usage Keeper URL
schema.description: Optional CPA Usage Keeper URL for CLIProxyAPI last-used accounts. Fusebox reports activity directly.

schema.label: Keeper password file
schema.description: Managed privately when saving the Keeper login password in settings. Advanced users can supply a private password file.

schema.label: T3 Code cost servers
schema.description: Managed in the Costs tab of settings. Remote servers with private token file references.

schema.label: Cost history from
schema.description: auto: Fusebox when Limits uses one (or a different Fusebox is set for Costs), otherwise this computer's transcripts. local: this computer's transcripts and T3 servers only. mixed: transcripts supply Claude and OpenAI; Fusebox adds its other providers.

schema.label: Fusebox cost connection
schema.description: limits: read Fusebox history with the Limits server and key. custom: a different Fusebox for Costs, at costFuseboxUrl with costFuseboxKeyFile.

schema.label: Fusebox cost server URL
schema.description: Fusebox server for Costs when costFuseboxConnection is custom.

schema.label: Fusebox cost key file
schema.description: Private Fusebox key file for Costs when costFuseboxConnection is custom. Managed in the Costs tab of settings.

schema.label: Live account activity
schema.description: Use one shared Fusebox stream for requests serving now. Older Rust proxies show unavailable activity.
